title: Violin with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='wood' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f0a04b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c1681f'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='wood2' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#d98030'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a5521a'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='46' y='8' width='8' height='34' rx='2' fill='#8a4a1a'/>
  <rect x='47.5' y='8' width='2' height='34' fill='#b56a30'/>
  <!-- scroll -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='6' fill='#8a4a1a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='3' fill='#5e2f0e'/>
  <!-- pegbox pegs -->
  <rect x='41' y='13' width='6' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#3a2008'/>
  <rect x='53' y='17' width='6' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#3a2008'/>
  <!-- strings on neck -->
  <rect x='49' y='8' width='0.8' height='34' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <rect x='50.2' y='8' width='0.8' height='34' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <rect x='51.4' y='8' width='0.8' height='34' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <!-- upper bout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='15' ry='12' fill='url(#wood)'/>
  <!-- waist -->
  <rect x='38' y='50' width='24' height='10' fill='#d98030'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='11' ry='7' fill='url(#wood)'/>
  <!-- lower bout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='75' rx='21' ry='17' fill='url(#wood)'/>
  <!-- purfling edge on lower bout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='75' rx='18' ry='14' fill='none' stroke='#f6c896' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- strings over body -->
  <rect x='49' y='42' width='0.8' height='40' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <rect x='50.2' y='42' width='0.8' height='40' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <rect x='51.4' y='42' width='0.8' height='40' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <!-- f-holes -->
  <path d='M41 62 q-3 4 0 8 q3 4 0 8' fill='none' stroke='#3a2008' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M59 62 q3 4 0 8 q-3 4 0 8' fill='none' stroke='#3a2008' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- bridge -->
  <rect x='43' y='70' width='14' height='3' rx='1' fill='#f0d8a8'/>
  <!-- tailpiece -->
  <path d='M46 78 L54 78 L52 90 L48 90 Z' fill='#3a2008'/>
  <!-- smiling face on upper bout -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='45' r='1.8' fill='#2a1404'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='45' r='1.8' fill='#2a1404'/>
  <path d='M44 49 q6 5 12 0' fill='none' stroke='#2a1404' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='40.5' cy='48' r='2' fill='#e86a6a' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='59.5' cy='48' r='2' fill='#e86a6a' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
